sonnet.problem: This card tells the moment the woman looks at the tree and moves toward eating the forbidden fruit, which is the first serious sin in the passage. It adds a joke, 'that tree's getting better reviews than my whole bakery', which makes the temptation sound appealing and funny.
sonnet.rule: **Heavy moments.** A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The right answer 'You will not surely die' is the Bible's own archaic wording. The wrong answers ('You will die much later', 'You will die if you touch it') are plain modern phrasing, so the right answer stands out by tone.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
